name: AI Deep Dive — AMD — 2026-05-02
rationale: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is successfully positioning itself as the sole viable alternative to NVIDIA in the AI accelerator market. With revenue growing at 34% and an exceptional Piotroski F-Score of 8, operational execution is near flawless. While trading at a premium 32x forward P/E, capturing even 15-20% of the hyperscaler AI budget justifies the $587B valuation. My weighted fair value of $443 indicates a solid 23% upside, making AMD a strong BUY for the AI infrastructure supercycle.

aiThesis.rationale: AMD has successfully established itself as the indispensable 'second source' to NVIDIA in the AI accelerator market (MI300X/MI400). Generating $6.7B in FCF with an F-Score of 8, the company is operationally pristine. Hyperscalers (Microsoft, Meta, Google) desperately need an alternative to NVIDIA to maintain pricing leverage, practically guaranteeing AMD a 15-20% market share floor. The base case ($401 PV) assumes AMD scales to $128B in revenue by Year 5 with software-like 25% net margins. If AMD can capture closer to 30% of the market (Bull Case $1,072), the upside is immense. At current prices, the risk/reward is highly favorable.
